description:
Robinson Jackson Lettings are delighted to present this exceptionally modern two-bedroom apartment in Peckham, positioned on the 21st floor and offering impressive views across London.

The property boasts a bright and spacious open-plan kitchen and reception room, creating a stylish space ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The modern fitted kitchen comes with a range of integrated white goods as well.

This property has two generously sized double bedrooms, with the master bedroom benefiting from a modern en-suite bathroom. 

Residents further benefit from a concierge service, and excellent transport links, making this an ideal home for professionals or couples seeking a well-connected city living.

With its fantastic London views, contemporary interiors and superb location, early viewing is highly recommended.

Key Features:
Two generously sized double bedrooms
Two modern bathrooms
En-suite bathroom to principal bedroom
Modern open-plan kitchen/reception room
Contemporary fitted kitchen
White goods included
Concierge service
Lift access
Double-glazed windows
Excellent transport links

Additional Information
Council Tax Band: D (Southwark)
Affordability criteria: £78,000
Deposit Required: £3,000

Sorry, no smokers.

Please request a copy of our Tenant Guidance Notes that outline the procedures and costs relating to completing a typical tenancy with us
